REAL-TIME CLOUD DETECTION & RESPONSE (CDR)
Mitiga AI-native CDR Platform
Real-time protection across cloud, SaaS, AI, and identity
Prevention has failed. Attackers inevitably get in. The question isn’t if you’ll be breached, but whether it will matter when you are.
Mitiga delivers
Zero-Impact Breach Prevention
, a radical shift from “zero breach” promises to a security model you can count on: eliminating impact.
‍
Our AI-native cloud detection and response platform unifies Cloud, SaaS, AI, and Identity into one always-on forensic system. From AI-powered detection to automated investigation and mitigation, Mitiga ensures that even when attackers break through, their efforts don’t materialize.
Every intrusion alert with Mitiga is the start of the attacker’s problem, not yours.
Request a demo
BEYOND POSTURE MANAGEMENT
Mitiga CDR: The active threat defense platform
Prevention tools like CSPM reduce risk, but they don’t stop live threats. AI-native active cloud defense is what turns a SOC from reactive to resilient. Mitiga CDR is purpose-built to arm your SOC team for the fight against active and AI-fueled cloud attacks.
01
Real-time cloud attack detection
Forget static misconfigurations. We hunt for behaviors. Our agentless platform continuously analyzes cloud and SaaS activity to spot behaviors such as compromised credentials, lateral movement, and data exfiltration before they become a headline.
02
Automated incident investigation
Stop the manual data chase. When a threat is detected, Mitiga correlates forensic data into a single attack timeline. What takes your team days or weeks, we deliver in minutes.
03
Rapid, guided response
Know your next move. Our platform provides playbooks and remediation steps so you can contain threats faster, reduce attacker dwell time, and minimize the blast radius of any incident.

PANORAMIC AWARENESS
Cloud Security Data Lake
Unlimited forensic depth. Zero blind spots.
Mitiga’s Cloud Security Data Lake powers Zero-Impact Breach Prevention with unlimited, normalized log storage across 1,000+ days.
Collects, enriches, and normalizes logs across SaaS, cloud providers, AI infrastructure, and identity platforms.
Eliminates SIEM data overload while ensuring you’re always investigation-ready.
Provides full-fidelity forensics to accelerate investigations and compliance.
ALWAYS ON
Cloud Threat Detection Investigation and Response (TDIR)
Always ready, always resilient.
Traditional cloud security tools miss lateral movement across SaaS, Cloud, AI, and Identity. Mitiga’s TDIR capability ensures you’re always prepared.
Continuous readiness assessments across ~100 platforms.
Automated investigation paths that reconstruct complete attack stories.
Clear visibility into strengths, gaps, and needed actions.
AI-NATIVE ATTACK MITIGATION

Contain attacks in minutes, not days.
When every second counts, CIRA automates the heavy lifting
Integrated workflows with cloud-native tools.
Automated investigation paths that surface breach context instantly.

ATTACK DECODING
Cloud Investigation Workbench
The story of every attack, at your fingertips.
Mitiga’s Cloud Investigation Workbench transforms fragmented signals into clear, contextual timelines.
Trace root causes across SaaS, Cloud, AI, and Identity.
Visualize attacker movement in real time.

ZERO IMPACT
All the data. All the time.
Attackers exploit the cloud’s sprawl. Mitiga turns that sprawl into resilience. By collecting and normalizing unlimited forensic data across your Cloud Service Providers, SaaS apps, AI ecosystems, and Identity systems, Mitiga ensures you always have the depth and context to investigate, contain, and report.
See the Mitiga platform in action, and get resilient.

FAQs
Mitiga AI-native Cloud Detection and Response (CDR) Platform
What is Zero-Impact Breach Prevention?
It’s Mitiga’s promise: attackers may get in, but they leave with nothing. By unifying Cloud, SaaS, AI, and Identity security, we eliminate the impact of breaches.
What teams benefit most from Mitiga?
Security teams stretched thin by manual investigations and alert fatigue. Whether you’re a lean SecOps function or a large SOC, Mitiga makes your response faster, clearer, and impact-free.
Why not just use AWS, Microsoft, or other native tools?
Native tools provide siloed visibility. Mitiga provides panoramic awareness, automated investigation, and unified timelines across all SaaS, Cloud, AI, and Identity systems.
How does Mitiga detect and contain attacks across SaaS and Cloud?
We use agentless, API-based monitoring with AI-driven detection rules and automated investigation paths, turning billions of signals into attack stories and enabling fast containment.
Is Mitiga only for post-breach investigations?
No. Mitiga's Security Data Lake and Continuous Monitoring, via it's powerful, AI-driven Detection Engine driving Attack Decoding, delivers industry leading preemptive security to stop attacks before damage is done.
